nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: All settings in one place: your live site URL and the email that receives admin mail.

parameters.query:
with candidates as (
  -- Signed up 1–7 days ago but never finished setting up
  select 'nudge_setup'::text as kind, p.id::text as entity_id, p.id as user_id,
         coalesce(p.role::text, 'none') as role, null::text as brief_title
    from profiles p
   where p.suspended_at is null and p.created_at between now() - interval '7 days' and now() - interval '1 day'
     and (p.role is null
          or (p.role = 'creator' and not exists (select 1 from creator_profiles c where c.user_id = p.id))
          or (p.role = 'cre' and not exists (select 1 from cre_profiles c where c.user_id = p.id)))
  union all
  -- Researchers with a profile but no ID verification yet, 1–14 days after signing up
  select 'nudge_verify', p.id::text, p.id, 'cre', null
    from profiles p join cre_profiles c on c.user_id = p.id
   where p.role = 'cre' and p.suspended_at is null
     and p.created_at between now() - interval '14 days' and now() - interval '1 day'
     and not exists (select 1 from kyc_submissions k where k.user_id = p.id)
  union all
  -- Briefs started 1–3 days ago but never paid, so researchers can't see them
  select 'nudge_brief', b.id::text, b.creator_id, 'creator', b.title
    from briefs b join profiles p on p.id = b.creator_id
   where b.status in ('draft', 'awaiting_payment') and p.suspended_at is null
     and b.created_at between now() - interval '3 days' and now() - interval '1 day'
)
select c.kind, c.entity_id, c.role, c.brief_title, u.email
  from candidates c
  join automation_user_contacts u on u.id = c.user_id
 where not exists (select 1 from admin_alert_log l where l.kind = c.kind and l.entity_id = c.entity_id)
 order by c.kind, c.entity_id
 limit 100

nodes.name: Who Needs a Nudge
nodes.notes: Three one-time reminders: finish setup, get verified (researchers), pay for a started brief (creators). Each is sent at most once ever.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ from: $('Config').first().json.from_email, to: [$json.email], subject: ($json.kind === 'nudge_brief' ? 'Your brief isn't live yet' : $json.kind === 'nudge_verify' ? 'One step left before you can pitch' : 'Finish setting up Outlier Desk'), text: (() => { const a = $('Config').first().json.app_url; const end = `

— The Outlier Desk team

This is a one-time reminder; we won't send it again.`; if ($json.kind === 'nudge_brief') return `Hi!

Your brief "${$json.brief_title || 'Untitled'}" isn't live yet, so researchers can't see it or pitch. Fund it to open it; any budget you don't use is refunded when it closes.

Finish it here: ${a}/briefs` + end; if ($json.kind === 'nudge_verify') return `Hi!

Your researcher profile is ready. The last step before you can pitch on paid briefs is ID verification (we review within 2 business days).

Verify here: ${a}/onboarding` + end; return `Hi!

You created an Outlier Desk account but haven't finished setting it up. It takes about two minutes.

Continue here: ${a}/onboarding` + end; })() }) }}

parameters.content:
## Onboarding nudges · daily 10:17 Manila
One-time emails that bring people back:
- signed up but didn't finish setup (after 1 day)
- researcher profile done but not verified (after 1 day)
- brief started but not paid (after 1 day)

**Setup:** same Resend credential and sending address as *Waitlist Welcome*.
